objective.force_source: Unthresholded normal-only ContactSensor.data.force_matrix_w from two distinct wheel/actual-ground filters; world Z with physical5ms impulse conversion.
objective.inherited_velocity_collection: Frozen sampler lifecycle also collects squared wheel-LINK vz, explicitly unused as a reward. The original LAST-substep vz reward remains unchanged; no velocity-cost read is allowed.
objective.integration: Unchanged RewardManager weight -1 times policy20ms. No extra5ms multiplier: -0.02*mean(costs) equals -0.005*sum(costs). Never apply exp after averaging forces.
objective.normalization: Actual startup live CPU link masses and native downward gravity; float64 mass reduction followed by cached float32CUDA mg per environment. No mass/gravity randomization or cache replacement.
objective.risks: Soft balanced-load preference at fixed total force, but also preference for larger total forces; may alter posture, suppress sideslip or favor impacts. All original motion/impact/height/stop gates remain authoritative. No PhysX/MuJoCo force-equivalence or hardware claim.

task_profile.description: Trial016 changes only ground-load-reserve quadrature relative to completed LR-synchronized trial013: mean of the four instantaneous exp(-max(F_ground_world_z,0)/(0.20*live_robot_weight)) costs, summed over two filtered wheels; not exp of mean force. Hold weight -1, last-substep wheel-vz, sideslip weight2, original500/10PD, original004 parent,600updates/2048envs/seed42, motor randomization, reference, friction, clocks and all behavior gates. The new opt-in handler reuses frozen native-window checks and also collects the inherited wheel-vz statistic without consuming it as a reward. No new teacher, physical step, actor call, observation, reset hook, contact-law fit or required50:50load split. Fresh GPU sampling, reset and performance checks precede learning. This soft reward does not certify uninterrupted bearing contact, force-model equivalence, hardware safety or statistical robustness.
